description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the HiveMqtt5PublisherActor, which interacts with an MQTT client to publish messages. The class sets up mocks for MQTT client interactions, verifies message publication properties, and ensures correct message handling in a testing environment.

classes.name: HiveMqtt5PublisherActorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the HiveMqtt5PublisherActor, focusing on message publishing behavior over MQTT using HiveMQ client library.

methods.name: setupMocks
methods.description: Sets up mock MQTT client and async client, and intercepts publish calls to store messages for verification.

methods.name: getPublisherActorProps
methods.description: Provides the actor Props for creating a HiveMqtt5PublisherActor with specified connection and MQTT client.

methods.name: decorateTarget
methods.description: Decorates and returns a Target object with a specific outbound address and acknowledgment label.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessage
methods.description: Asserts that a message was published with specific topic, payload, properties, and content type.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessageToReplyTarget
methods.description: Asserts that a reply message was published to the reply target topic.

methods.name: verifyAcknowledgements
methods.description: Verifies that acknowledgements received match expected labels and status codes.

methods.name: getOutboundAddress
methods.description: Returns the outbound MQTT address used in tests.
